text:
sam: Evening handoff — planning to push kernel v4.2.1 + new quant profile 'slim-8' during the 21:00 UTC quiet window. Who can own the deploy and run the quick smoke?
anya: I can run the deploy step (i'll be on-call). Can someone pair on rollback and logs so we can act fast if needed?
matt: I can own rollback and watch logs. I'll standby from 20:50–22:10 UTC. Which canary slice are we using?
sam: Canary: slice=canary-3 (10% traffic). Rollout plan: deploy to canary-3 -> 15m smoke -> if OK, ramp to 3 more slices over 30m. Manual hold between stages.
anya: CR check: PR #4321 (kernel + quant) is approved by lina earlier today. @lina can you confirm there were no last-minute changes?
lina: Confirmed — no code changes since approval. Only config tweak to default batch size for slim-8. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy job created: job/rollout-2865123456 (targets: canary-3, timeout: 1800s)
sam: Quick smoke checklist (small ops runbook):
```bash
# run from jumpbox
./tools/deploy --job job/rollout-2865123456 --confirm
# smoke check (tail logs + simple gen)
kubectl logs -l rl-slice=canary-3 -n prod --tail=200 | grep -i error || true
curl -sS -X POST https://api.prod/redwood/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello","max_tokens":8}' | jq '.text'
```
anya: I'll run the deploy command and the post-deploy smoke. matt — if you see any error patterns in logs, trigger rollback with `./tools/rollback --job job/rollout-2865123456`.
matt: Got it. What rollback signal should we look for? High tail-latency, OOMs, or generation errors >1% in smoke? Recommend:
- p95 latency increase > 40% vs baseline
- any OOMs in the last 5m
- generation failure rate > 1.5% on smoke prompt set
lina: Also watch for mismatch in kv-cache hits after quant change — observed a small regression in staging last time. Check `kv_cache.hit_rate` in telemetry dashboard.
sam: Good call. I'll keep the rollout paused between canary -> partial roll so we can evaluate metrics.
anya: Timeline: I'll start deploy at 21:00 UTC. Can we have a quick preflight at 20:50 to validate creds, configs, and slot availability?
matt: I'll join preflight at 20:50 and confirm rollback steps are available. If anything weird, i'll call for immediate rollback and mark the deploy as aborted.
anya: Preflight checklist quick notes:
- kubectl context = prod (checked)
- job container image SHA = sha256:abc123 (matches PR)
- monitor dashboards pinned (latency / errors / kv cache)
- escalation channel = #eng-oncall
sam: perfect. i'll post a final GO / NO-GO at 20:58 UTC. Ping me in-thread if you're blocked.
anya: Copy. I'll post smoke outputs in this thread.
sam: thanks everyone — see you at 20:50. :coffee:
